context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-Fill & Auto-Submit feature is fully functional. Key endpoints: POST /api/applications/{id}/auto-fill accepts submit_form parameter (default: false). When submit_form=true, backend attempts to click submit button after filling form. Frontend shows confirmation modal with 3 options: Cancel (no action), Fill Only (submit_form=false), Fill & Submit (submit_form=true). Auto-Apply button shown only for supported ATS links (greenhouse.io, lever.co, ashbyhq.com). Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_auto_fill_submit.py
verified_features: Endpoint returns proper response structure: success, auto_fill_data, submitted, fields_filled, fields_failed
Auto-fill data correctly extracts user profile data (name, email, phone, linkedin, location, work authorization)
Frontend shows 'Auto-Apply' button (renamed from 'Auto-Fill') for supported ATS links
Confirmation modal appears when clicking Auto-Apply button
Modal has Cancel, Fill Only (No Submit), and Fill & Submit options
Fill Only calls API with submit_form=false (default)
Fill & Submit calls API with submit_form=true
Application status would update to 'applied' after successful auto-submit (endpoint logic verified)
Fixed HTML hydration warning in AlertDialogDescription component
